UC-1293.note: The composer's status line, in the model and effort menus' place, quiet words and no control, until the host's probe has filled the agent's models (a new conversation, a held plan, or a conversation with no session yet). Replaces the seed's "{agent}'s default" and "Default effort" (UC-874, UC-884, retired): no made-up default is shown

UC-1370.en: Couldn't read the models yet. You can still ask.
UC-1370.note: The composer's status line, in the model and effort menus' place, quiet words and no control, while the host's probe of the agent's models failed or timed out and nothing fills them (AgentSummary.models_unread, true through the host's bounded retries). Ask stays enabled; the menus come once a probe or a session fills the models. Beside UC-1293's "Loading models…". New

UC-1372.en: Models show after your first message.
UC-1372.note: The composer's status line, in the model and effort menus' place, quiet words and no control, where the firm requires the sandbox (ProtectionView.required): every usage read is refused there, so the host runs no probe and the models come with the first session. In place of "Loading models…", which would never end. Ask stays enabled. New

UC-1371.en: {name} couldn't use the model or effort you picked for this answer, so it used {model} at {effort} effort.
UC-1371.note: A quiet notice row at the top of an answer whose model or effort pick (SendPrompt.config, create_thread's config or set_config_option) the agent couldn't use: the host's pick_not_used notice, sent once before the turn starts, naming what the answer ran with: the model and the effort. {name} is the agent, Claude or ChatGPT. The fields say what ran, not which pick failed, so the words name both picks. The status line shows the turn's record. Never an error. New

UC-1373.en: {name} couldn't use the model or effort you picked for this answer, so it used {model}.
UC-1373.note: A quiet notice row at the top of an answer whose model or effort pick (SendPrompt.config, create_thread's config or set_config_option) the agent couldn't use: the host's pick_not_used notice, sent once before the turn starts, naming what the answer ran with: the model only (the session names no effort). {name} is the agent, Claude or ChatGPT. The fields say what ran, not which pick failed, so the words name both picks. The status line shows the turn's record. Never an error. New

UC-1374.en: {name} couldn't use the model or effort you picked for this answer, so it used {effort} effort.
UC-1374.note: A quiet notice row at the top of an answer whose model or effort pick (SendPrompt.config, create_thread's config or set_config_option) the agent couldn't use: the host's pick_not_used notice, sent once before the turn starts, naming what the answer ran with: the effort only (the session names no model). {name} is the agent, Claude or ChatGPT. The fields say what ran, not which pick failed, so the words name both picks. The status line shows the turn's record. Never an error. New

UC-1375.en: {name} couldn't use the model or effort you picked for this answer, so it kept the settings it had.
UC-1375.note: A quiet notice row at the top of an answer whose model or effort pick (SendPrompt.config, create_thread's config or set_config_option) the agent couldn't use: the host's pick_not_used notice, sent once before the turn starts, naming what the answer ran with: neither (the session names none). {name} is the agent, Claude or ChatGPT. The fields say what ran, not which pick failed, so the words name both picks. The status line shows the turn's record. Never an error. New

UC-1376.note: The composer's status line in a conversation, quiet words after the model and effort menus, while the lawyer's pick differs from the turn's record the menus name (during an answer, or after one): the pick, which goes with the next message as SendPrompt.config, steers included; {settings} is the model and effort by the agent's names, " · " between ("Next message: Opus 5.5 · High"). It stays until a turn starts with the pick, or the host says the agent couldn't use it (pick_not_used). New

UC-1378.hi_by: app track (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-1378.note: One quiet line of plain words at the foot of the composer's open model menu, nothing to press, while the agent runs in code mode: ChatGPT always (Codex runs every plan model in code mode); Claude as its conversation's last finished answer ran (StepEntry.code_mode), and before any answer when the picked model is Claude 5.5 or newer. Absent otherwise, with no warning. Replaces the per-answer "Code mode" tag and its spoken sentence (UC-1294, UC-1295, retired): on today's plans nearly every answer runs in code mode, so a mark on each only repeated. Orchestrator r7636. New
